decisions.reason: The single-tube air fin cooler is close to the core offer and cheap to keep listed, and although the related single-tube condensers were dropped, two years of evidence do not yet clearly show its value is unattainable, so the option stays open with somewhat higher abandonment risk.
The tube liner supports the growing lifecycle service and repair business at minimal holding cost, so keeping this low-cost option preserves upside while demand evidence accumulates.

The customized air cooler line with several models embodies the firm's integrated custom-solution strategy and offers many paths for further investment, so its option value clearly justifies keeping it.
The tube end repair inserts strengthen the spare parts and repair business at negligible cost, so there is no reason to abandon an option that is cheap to hold and still resolving its demand.
